config.notes: Course pages (www.westernsydney.edu.au/future/study/courses/<level>/<course>) are read through Firecrawl (page_view render, no address change: the course page has no international address; the international fee column is filled in by the page script, so a plain fetch shows only the domestic summary panel on most pages; tested 5 Oct). Start dates are printed as full dates after "Next Start Date" in the summary panel. The international annual fee is the AUD figure in the "Indicative annual fee" row after the domestic value (CSP or "from $"), or the internationalFees value in the page component data where a plain fetch kept it; no fee year is printed next to it. Duration and campuses are in the summary panel; the course page prints no delivery mode beyond the campus list. The pages do not print IELTS (only a generic international entry note): central rule at westernsydney.edu.au/international/studying/entry-requirements is IELTS Academic 6.5 overall, no band below 6.0, higher for nursing, allied health, medicine, teaching, social work and professional psychology. Handbook pages (handbook.westernsydney.edu.au/2021-2025) are archived editions with no fees or start dates; only study mode, location and AQF level are read from them. Courses bound to the handbook were rebound to their own course page where it appears in stored links (5 Oct).
